title: Fix Catalogue Tiles Morph To Labels
description: Bauteilarten (#/0/10) to Bauteilbeschriftungen (#/0/11): many-to-one tile morph. Only one element transitions; embodiment switches before position morph so text morphs instead of tiles. Fix settle/bridge ordering so all column tiles animate into labels.
summary:
Fixed Bauteilarten (slide 10) and catalogue-labels bridge (slide 11) showing blank.

- Removed opaque overlay DispositionFrame on morphParticipant column anchors so focus tiles are visible.
- arrangementWithVisibleMorphBridgeGhosts: bridge slides show column crop ghosts at rest instead of all-opacity-0.
- PresentationInteractionContext.Provider in PresentationDeck (render was crashing).
- CSS: display:contents on unpinned interactive wrappers; removed height:100% on positioned slides.

Verified in browser: #/0/10 tiles, #/0/11 column crops, #/0/12 labels. Tests: core 43, renderer 30 passing.
